name: family
description: A family tree under the answer, for a question about family: someone's relatives, or how two people are related. Give the person it is drawn around and the people the results named, by path — or, for how two people are related, the other one as to.

person.description: The person the tree is drawn around.

people.description: The people the answer is about, as the results named them.

to.description: For how two people are related: the other one; the tree is the line of relations between them.

name: map
description: A map under the answer, only when the user asks where something is or for a map. Name the locations and pictures a result gave you by path, and the areas location-region looked up by the name you gave it; name nothing to pin the pictures the answer shows. The app pins each one where the archive has it: never write coordinates.

title.description: A short title, in the language of the reply.

paths.description: Locations or pictures a result named.

areas.description: Areas location-region looked up this turn: a city, a country.
